_help: Used to turn the charger operator's fee into an estimated total, the way Miio bills it.
total = (operator fee + session kWh x (app energy + grid access + excise) + app activation + MOBI.E fee) x (1 + VAT of the charger's region)
Edit the numbers here when they change; the site picks them up on the next deploy.

sources.app_energy_kwh: Miio session breakdown at FUN-00003, Nov 2026: energy EUR 3.04 for 10 kWh
sources.grid_access_kwh: Same Miio breakdown: grid access (TAR) EUR 0.78 for 10 kWh
sources.excise_kwh: Same Miio breakdown: Special Consumption Tax (IEC) EUR 0.01 for 10 kWh
sources.app_activation: Miio activation was EUR 0 ('miio offer'); raise it here if Miio starts charging one
sources.mobie_fee_session: Not shown as a separate line in Miio's breakdown, so 0
sources.vat_by_region: Portuguese standard VAT: 23% mainland, 22% Madeira, 16% Azores

grid_access_note: TAR and IEC values come from a Madeira session; mainland and Azores use the same national ERSE tariffs as an estimate
